# E0362: a lens reads a field its source schema does not declare

A lens reads a field its source schema does not declare. No instance of the
source has it, so the lens never has a value to copy.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				b: string
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			b: v0_0.nope
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.b
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0362]: b in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 copies v0_0.nope, which the source schema does not declare
  --> lineage.cue:22:7
   |
22 |             b: v0_0.nope
   |                ^^^^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule source-undeclared)
```
